_comment: Single source of truth for the desk-event flash grammar. Consumed by bin/rgb-flash + hue-stream/pc-rgb-effect.py (color+envelope), bin/desk-event (caption), bin/flash-toast (banner color/label/emoji), all via lib/flash-lib.sh accessors. Per event: `color` = palette key (traffic-light: yellow=needs/help, green=done, red=error, white=fyi); `peak` 0..1 brightness; `segs` = [[seconds, lit?], ...] envelope (lit seg = swell; false = gap between pulses); `scope` = name/room substrings the Hue flash is limited to (omit = whole-room wash); `label`+`emoji` = how the toast/banner names it.
